messages:
nina.engineer: Heads up  I'll be in Oslo for 10 days (2026-07-05 to 2026-07-14) to visit family and work remotely. Quick q's: 1) do we prorate the WFH allowance for short stints? 2) Can I take my company laptop + docking station in checked baggage? 3) Any Norway payroll/social security flags I should know about?

alex.peopleops: Thanks for flagging, nina. Please fill the temp remote form: https://intranet.redwood/people-ops/forms/temp-remote and mark "personal travel". For 10 days we typically don't adjust monthly stipend unless the trip spans the payroll month boundary; we do a calendar-day proration only when someone is away for more than 14 days in a month. So no change expected here.

marta.tax: Short answer on taxes: Norway has a 183-day rule for tax residency, so 10 days is fine. Two caveats: if you work for a Norway-based client or local contractor while there, that can create PE/payroll complexity. Also social security: short personal trips are usually ok but keep records of dates/timezones and no billed local work. If you end up extending, tell us ASAP.

nina.engineer: Good to know. No local clients. Will submit form now. Re: hardware  any restrictions about taking the docking station?

it-asset-bot: Asset policy: company laptop may be taken for travel. Docking station is company property too  you can take it temporarily but must log the asset transfer in the portal: https://assets.redwood/checkout. Do NOT leave equipment unattended at hotels.

jay.teamlead: Approved. Please set your calendar to UTC+2 availability for those dates and post any on-call swaps if needed.

alex.peopleops: One practical note on stipend: if you want us to reimburse checked-bag fees for extra equipment, submit it as an expense with "temp remote equipment shipping" tag. Expense policy requires receipts and confirmation that items are returned to the company.

nina.engineer: Form submitted (TR-2026-0812) and asset checkout recorded. I filed a baggage expense estimate for docking station (will attach receipts).

marta.tax: Thanks. Two small asks: 1) add a short note in the form confirming no local contracts/invoices; 2) keep a simple travel log (dates, wifi usage for work) in case payroll asks.

people-ops-bot: Temp remote request received: temp_location=Norway start_date=2026-07-05 end_date=2026-07-14 submitted_by=nina.engineer request_id=TR-2026-0812

alex.peopleops: Noted. We'll queue stipend as usual (no proration). We'll process any approved baggage expense in next expense run once receipts are in. Have a great trip! :airplane:

nina.engineer: Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
